ambient_events: The hose drips into the drain, patient and steady.
A row of chalked lockers holds other people's tablets, all of them dark, all of them staying that way.
Someone has written above the mirror, in a careful hand: THE MACHINE KNOWS YOU BY WHAT YOU CARRY.
description: A tiled room with a run of lead-lined lockers along one wall, each with a name chalked on the door, and a drain in the middle of the floor. Anything that can be listened to goes in a locker before you go any further in: tablet, chip, anything with a cell in it. There's a hose fed from somewhere upstream and a mirror bolted at eye height, and beside the mirror a set of calipers and a probe, because the Watch check for chrome and they don't take your word for it.
name: The Lockers
